spec.data_count: 3 scales x 3 benchmarks = 7 fits (0.5B only gsm8k due to D045)

experiment_data.notes: Scale-stratified 2PL+gamma IRT: gamma NOT monotonically scale-dependent. CIs overlap 0 for most strata (N=6-8 underpowered). 3B GSM8K drives bulk of pooled calibration gain (dMAE=0.155). 1.5B shows anomalous negative gamma (noise). Only 1.5B ARC has significant gamma (1.17) but PPP=0.013 indicates poor fit.
